findings.description: An old VS Code lake serve process used Lean 4.32.1 against this Lean 4.33.1 checkout and produced incompatible artifacts. Some existing Mathlib artifacts also used Lean 4.30.0-rc2.
findings.resolution: Stopped the confirmed stale Lean 4.32.1 language-server processes; VS Code automatically restarted the root project with Lean 4.33.1. Restored 8690 pinned Mathlib cache artifacts with lake exe cache get!. The selected upstream proof cone and full OpenGALib build then passed.

findings.description: The selected theorem requires global completeness and a global Ricci lower bound with nonpositive model curvature. The platform milestone also covers positive model curvature and ball-local hypotheses.
findings.resolution: Expose and verify the covered cases only; leave the full platform milestone Open.

findings.description: The old lake exe shake command no longer exists. The built-in lake shake requires new-style module headers throughout the import closure, while the current local and upstream sources include legacy modules.
findings.remaining_work: Migrate the local and upstream import closure to the Lean module system before re-enabling import minimization.
findings.resolution: CI now invokes lake shake and explicitly reports the known unsupported-module limitation instead of counting a failed command as zero suggestions. Other command failures remain fatal; full builds and transitive theorem axiom audits remain enforced.

foundation_refactor.declarations: Existing public declaration names and geometric hypotheses preserved; basic interfaces relocated.

platform_publication.import_closure_note: The 443-file local upstream import closure is not a platform node count. Declaration-level reachability and extraction are required before deciding the upload set.

observations: RicciBoundedBelow expands to a pointwise lower bound for the Ricci tensor of the supplied metric.
The Ricci tensor traces the curvature of the metric Levi-Civita connection.
The Riemannian measure is built from chart densities with proven invariance.
The main result concerns actual distance balls at arbitrary positive radii, using the minimizing segment domain and a proved polar integration identity.
The one-dimensional branch is handled explicitly in segBall_vol_rel.
The model uses sinh(q*r)/q for q>0 and r for q=0; it does not cover positive model curvature.
Keep the immutable upstream dependency and original declarations; no wholesale source copy.
The OpenGA API takes one explicit metric for distances, volume and Ricci bounds; it constructs the required compatible metric instances internally.
Upstream source attribution and exact commit are retained.
The selected upstream import cone is large; subsequent builds should reuse verified artifacts.
No claim of runtime numerical efficiency is relevant to these noncomputable mathematical declarations.
No sorry, admit, explicit axiom, or unsafe keyword occurs in the selected upstream source cone.
The transitive axiom audit of five upstream results and all eleven public local definitions/theorems found only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.

scope: Review and reuse the complete connected boundaryless manifold Bishop-Gromov comparison for global Ricci lower bound -(n-1) q^2, q>=0; specialize to nonnegative Ricci and volume doubling. This does not cover the entire platform milestone.
